senses.gloss:
जुङ्ग mf. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा) A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.)
 E. जुगि to quit,
affix अच्, removing all blemishes; also with कन् added जुङ्गक
m. (-कः.)

जुङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Outcaste, deserted, injured, abandoned.
 m. (-तः)
A man of a degraded caste, a Chandala, &c.
 E. जुगि to abandon,
affix क्त.
